title: Bully
note: Accurate South Florida; the build up matters more than the killing.

title: Donnie Brasco
note: Organized crime as a dull job; Pacino as a passed over middle manager.

title: Sleepers
note: Patient revenge built on Monte Cristo; the Kevin Bacon scene is top five.

title: Pacific Heights
note: A horror film whose weapon is paperwork.

title: Collateral
note: Cruise's best role; digital LA night photography.

title: Bone Tomahawk
note: Defends the slow first act; the climax is a catastrophe.

title: Breakdown
note: A film about class anxiety; Russell deliberately soft, J.T. Walsh menacing.

title: The Insider
note: A scientist whose conscience is tested by his expertise.

title: Locke
note: A film about project management; concrete as irreversible choice. Five stars.

title: Sneakers
note: Underrated ensemble; prophetic about privacy.

title: Margin Call
note: One night of finance; Irons standout; Spacey and Bettany exchange is the core.

title: Sorcerer
note: Wages of Fear remake; rope bridge; Tangerine Dream; flopped against Star Wars.

title: Enter the Void
note: A mind dissolving, told from a dead man's point of view.

title: Sexy Beast
note: Kingsley's Don Logan as relentless villain.

title: Michael Clayton
note: A fixer facing middle aged regret; the ending asks what remains of a man.

title: Rogue Trader
note: A fable about hidden losses; not a masterpiece and he says so.

title: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
note: Very hard to watch; recommended anyway.

title: Wonder Boys
note: Honest portrait of creative work; underseen.

title: Shotgun Stories
note: Quiet Southern film about the damage fathers do.

title: Overnight
note: Troy Duffy documentary; tragic and beautiful.
